Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

anyFit 2.1.0

  • fitlm_burr(), fitlm_dagum(), fitlm_gengamma(), fitlm_gengamma_loc() and fitlm_expweibull() use a new shared L-moment solver. The two shapes are solved from the scale-free L-ratios by L-BFGS-B on log-shapes (Stacy (k, d) coordinates for the generalised gamma), and the scale is derived analytically. The fit is restarted once from the second-nearest seed if it stalls. The fits reproduce the sample L-ratios to about 1e-7 instead of 1e-4, take 10–15 objective evaluations instead of 70–110, and no longer end on an artificial scale bound. This changes the generalised gamma and exponentiated Weibull fits substantially; Burr XII and Dagum fits change by about 1e-4.
  • Wider shape bounds: Burr XII shape1 <= 1e4, Dagum shape2 <= 0.95, exponentiated Weibull shape2 <= 1e4. The generalised gamma requires shape1 / shape2 >= 0.01, where its quadrature is accurate. The *_InitValues seed tables are extended to cover the new bounds.
  • The fitters return Diag (status, resid, convergence, evals, restarts). status is one of "matched", "matched_at_bound", "outside_domain" (the sample L-ratios lie outside the family’s attainable region; the fit is the closest the family can get) or "not_converged".
  • order now selects L-ratios: order 2 matches the L-CV, order r >= 3 matches tau_r, and lambda_1 always sets the scale. At least two ratios are required.
  • The attainable-region polygons BurrXII_LSpace, Dagum_LSpace, GGamma_LSpace and ExpWeibull_LSpace used by LRatio_check() are regenerated over the new bounds (data-raw/make_LSpace.R). The exponentiated Weibull region was previously far too small.
  • qburr(), rburr() and dburr() are evaluated in log space and no longer overflow for large shape1 * shape2.

anyFit 2.0.0

  • Introduced the sxts (spatial xts) S3 class, which stores coordinates and projection alongside the time series and preserves them through subsetting, arithmetic, lagging, differencing and aggregation.
  • Added native spatial operations for sxts: bounding-box and shapefile masking (mask.sxts()), zonal statistics over polygons (zonal_stats()), and bidirectional raster conversion (rasterFromSxts(), sxtsFromRaster()).
  • nc2xts() reads NetCDF directly and clips on load by country, continent, bounding box or shapefile, returning an sxts.
  • Gridded counterparts of the point-based tools: basic_stats_nc(), monthly_stats_nc(), period_apply_nc(), fitlm_nc() and fitlm_monthly_nc(), with optional parallel fitting.
  • Distribution fitting by the method of L-moments across sixteen families, including the flexible Burr type-XII, Dagum, Generalised Gamma and Exponentiated Weibull, with L-ratio diagnostic diagrams (LRatio_check()).
  • A rebuilt documentation website with articles driven entirely by the bundled E-OBS example dataset.
